_ASSUMED_evolution_loop._comment: ASSUMPTION (workbench-evolution-loop-evals): the design spec (2026-07-02-admin-evolution-loop-design.md) never names a config file or schema for the persona roster / trigger thresholds. This block is a plausible shape modeled on the existing dial_overrides convention, invented for this eval suite so the trigger-condition and persona-roster cases have something concrete to seed. If the real implementation lands with a different file path or key names, update EVOLUTION_CONFIG_PATH in cases/lib.sh and this block's keys to match — the eval INTENT (roster of 5 personas, dual mandate, two trigger conditions) stays valid either way.
